title: Light/archived web fingerprint, third-party posture graders and site contacts (batch p9-G03-2: P072, P076, P077)
owner: batch p9-G03-2 (web_fingerprint, web_fingerprint_archive, posture_third_party, ssllabs_assess, site_contacts, site_contacts_archive)
notes: Core names are reused where they fit: technologies, http_status, title, server, waf, archive_snapshot, third_party_counts; relations redirects_to, cname_to, has_vuln, same_analytics, contact_email, phone_of, company_of, pix_key_of, links_to; tags version_inferred, kev, phishing, privacy, inconclusive.

attributes.waf_cdn: passive WAF/CDN attribution [{name, kind waf|cdn_or_proxy|cdn, evidence, source header|cookie|cname}]: wafw00f header/cookie subset (BSD-3) on a normal response plus CNAME suffixes, never an attack probe (P072 cond 6)
attributes.fingerprint_verdict: whether a fetched or archived page could be fingerprinted {verdict ok|not_html|inconclusive|proxy_error|challenge|corporate_proxy, reason, vendor, http_status, final_url}: 4xx/5xx and proxy error bodies are inconclusive (P072 cond 7)
attributes.redirect_chain: hop URLs of a LIGHT homepage fetch, in order (each hop re-checked by the core guard, at most 5)
attributes.cpe_guesses: CPE 2.3 guesses from a detected technology version [{technology, version, cpe}] (CR16: low confidence, input for CVE lookups)
attributes.technology_cves: version-inferred CVEs kept as context instead of findings (hostile pages, archived snapshots) [{technology, version, cve_count, cve_ids, max_cvss, max_severity, kev, label}]
attributes.own_rule_hits: V3LUM own (MIT) phishing-kit / panel signature hits on a page [{name, kind phishing_kit|panel, hits}] (P072 cond 4)
attributes.fingerprint_db: technology fingerprint data used for a match {source webappanalyzer|bundled_test, technologies, patterns, compiled, skipped, budget_skipped, ignored_keys, time_budget_hit}: GPL-3.0 data downloaded at runtime, never bundled
attributes.hsts_preload: HSTS preload list state from hstspreload.org /api/v2/status {status, preloaded, via_parent, preloaded_domain, bulk, checked_at}
attributes.ssllabs_endpoints: SSL Labs grades per endpoint [{ip, grade, grade_trust_ignored, has_warnings, status_message, protocols, vulnerabilities, hsts_status, forward_secrecy, cert_chain_issues, assessed_at, cached}]: a cached second opinion next to tls_inspect/security_headers, dated by the SSL Labs assessment time
attributes.ssllabs_assessment: one SSL Labs assessment {host, status, start_time, test_time, engine_version, criteria_version, polls, publish off}: ACTIVE ssllabs_assess only
attributes.posture_sources: per-grader outcome of posture_third_party {source: ok | empty | no_cached_grade | could_not_verify | skipped_licence | manual_link}
attributes.site_contacts: organisational contacts published by a site {emails [{address, relation}], phones [{number, kind}], whatsapp [{number, kind}], social [{platform, handle, url}], invites [{kind, url}], cnpjs, pix_keys [{type, value}]}: role/corporate contacts and official profiles only (P077 cond 4-5)
attributes.privacy_mentions: personal contacts of natural persons kept as privacy-tagged mentions (org-profile own sites, or hostile sites with a recorded purpose) [{type, value, kind, privacy}]: CPF only masked, never pivoted (P077 cond 6)
attributes.crawl_summary: bounded same-site crawl of site_contacts {pages_planned, pages_fetched, pages, refused [{url, reason}] (e-mail or token paths withheld), capped, robots, site_class}

relations.site_social_profile: site/domain -> social profile URL or account the site itself links as its official profile (self-declared on the site, never verified ownership)
